name: gpu-sidebar
description: OpenCode TUI sidebar plugin: live GPU utilization/memory bars styled like btop's meters, with a bundled HTTP reporter for remote GPU hosts. NVIDIA only.
author: thdrzinger

scripts.build:tui: bun build src/tui.tsx --outfile dist/tui.js --target bun --format esm --external @opencode-ai/plugin --external @opentui/core --external @opentui/solid --external solid-js
scripts.build:reporter: tsc --target es2022 --module es2022 --moduleResolution bundler --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --outDir dist --skipLibCheck src/reporter.ts && chmod +x dist/reporter.js
scripts.build: npm run build:tui && npm run build:reporter
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test
